title: A measure for genuine tripartite entanglement
summary: We introduce a real-valued functional $I(\vec{n}_1,\vec{n}_2)$ of four three-qubit correlations that turns the Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger (GHZ) algebraic paradox into a quantitative witness of genuine tripartite entanglement. For every three-qubit state $ρ$ and every pair of directions, $|I(\vec{n}_1,\vec{n}_2;ρ)|\le 2$, with equality if and only if $\vec{n}_1\perp\vec{n}_2$ and $ρ$ is locally unitarily equivalent to the GHZ state.
